headline: Somniwing build
title: Somniwing Best Build | Regen Is Everything | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Somniwing is your energy battery, so build it for Regen. Its base Regen of one hundred fifteen is its best stat, and HP comes second. Take Ethereal Light Wave, which boosts your teammates' energy recovery for twenty seconds, and Energy Orb. The best held item is the Spirited Feather, which adds extra Regen every level. Swap it in when your team runs low on energy. Do you use Somniwing? Comment below!
description: Somniwing best build in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Regen first then HP, Ethereal Light Wave and Energy Orb, Spirited Feather held item (0.7 extra Regen per level).
